bagPolicy.summary: Busch Stadium does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Busch Stadium can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Busch Stadium's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Busch Stadium offers a variety of food and drink options, including local favorites and classic ballpark fare. Fans can enjoy specialty items and themed food offerings during games.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Guest Relations Centers are located on Level 1, Section 148 behind homeplate and Level 4 behind section 340 and Ford Plaza near the Sensory Room and are staffed by specially trained ushers. Accessible seating is readily available on all levels and in all price categories of Busch Stadium.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Guests with a hand stamp and valid event ticket can re-enter the stadium at any gate from the times gate open until 90 minutes after scheduled first pitch. Once guests have had their tickets scanned and have entered Busch Stadium, they must proceed to either Gate 1 or Gate 4 to receive a hand stamp if they want to exit and re-enter the stadium.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Busch Stadium uses mobile ticketing. Tickets already retrieved in the MLB Ballpark app are not available for Will Call pickup; if you cannot access a valid mobile ticket, visit a Busch Stadium Ticket Office window for assistance.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Busch Stadium gates open 1 ½ hours before game time Monday - Thursday and 2 hours before game time Friday - Sunday Busch Stadium gates open 1.5 hours before game time Monday - Thursday and 2 hours before game time Friday – Sunday.
